A '''potato''' is a raw [[ingredient]] with no [[intrinsic]]. It doesn't heal when eaten raw, but a [[Baked Potato|baked potato]] heals {{Hp|5}}, and potatoes are the base of several filling meals.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_potato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
A raw potato keeps its vanilla food values and doesn't heal.

Picking up a potato unlocks the baked potato recipe. Baked potatoes are used in [[Pickled Potatoes|pickled potatoes]], [[latke]]s, [[gnocchi]] and [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]]. Raw potatoes go into [[seitan]] and [[Curry Stock|curry stock]]. A potato cooked in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] becomes a [[Charred Potato|charred potato]].

=== Poisonous potato ===
Poisonous potatoes are unchanged, but the item is the base of most of the pack's foods: [[Pumpkin Empanada|pumpkin empanada]]s, jams and most meals are poisonous potatoes with a custom name, model and food component. Natural poisonous potatoes have no use in cooking.
